title: occ_sim: an open, physics-grounded benchmark of LED-matrix optical camera communication schemes
description: Simulation-only, physics-grounded benchmark of LED-matrix optical camera communication (OCC) schemes: EMVA 1288 sensor model, rolling shutter, Bayer CFA with Malvar-He-Cutler demosaicing, real corner finder, equal optical power, common random numbers, bootstrap CIs and Holm-corrected claims. Ships per-symbol error arrays (npz), a sha256 manifest and reproduce.sh. Results are simulation results only; no claim is made for real hardware.

creators.name: Salvi, Sanket
creators.affiliation: MIT World Peace University (MIT-WPU), Pune, India
